name: Ulder Ravengard
backstory:
__NOTOC__

Grand Duke Ulder Ravengard is the human Supreme Marshall of the Flaming Fist and the father of Wyll. His story stretches through all three acts of Baldur's Gate 3, and he can become a Camp Follower late in the game. 

Ulder Ravengard is a recurring character in the Forgotten Realms setting of Dungeons and Dragons, appearing in the 5e adventures: ', ', and ''''.
